meta.name: designing-distributed-systems
meta.description: When designing distributed systems for scalability, reliability, and consistency. Covers CAP/PACELC theorems, consistency models (strong, eventual, causal), replication patterns (leader-follower, multi-leader, leaderless), partitioning strategies (hash, range, geographic), transaction patterns (saga, event sourcing, CQRS), resilience patterns (circuit breaker, bulkhead), service discovery, and caching strategies for building fault-tolerant distributed architectures.

copy.tagline: 设计可扩展、高可靠的分布式系统架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计或评估分布式系统的架构方案。
